db_maintenance.sh size loop: above DB_MAX_SIZE_GB it lowers retention step by step, but pruned rows now move into the archive, so the DB does not shrink and the loop prunes down to 1 day. 016 capture: timeouts on every host (ConnectTimeout/ReadTimeout) are not seen as an outage by the shared SourcePageDownloader, so they count as attempts; four such nights give up a document. Fix in the shared downloader if it happens.
